summary: Project Armor III adds an external Godot worker watchdog and bounded output. Armor II has passed its final checks and is merged. New Rust worker behavior and integrated E2E await current-head CI.

passed: Armor II Windows compile and expanded real Godot E2E
Armor II recovery and memory workflows also passed
observations.note: Armor II merged via PR #2 as 6cbf251. New worker tests must pass before SAFE-2 acceptance.

limits: No sandbox, disk power-loss certification or protection against deliberately escaped hostile processes.
Windows watchdog covers engine version/import/tests/export/smoke only. Normal gameplay remains untimed.
Linux process groups support tests and normal deadlines, not recovery of a persisted Windows job.
Cancellation is a tested worker API, not a desktop Cancel button. No installer delivered by this pass.
handoff: Inspect SAFE-2 branch/PR and current-head Worker Watchdog, Recovery Safety, Project Memory and Windows compile/Godot E2E results. Do not repeat implementation or merge based on prior-head results. Read engine module first.
